summary: Universal API client (utils/api.js) verification - All tests passed. The new apiRequest() function correctly uses standard fetch on web platform. Tested all auth flows: login with valid/invalid/empty credentials, dashboard navigation, session persistence (10+ seconds), protected route redirect, and logout.

issues: Console warnings about DialogContent missing DialogTitle for accessibility (Radix UI) - minor accessibility improvement

passed_tests: Backend: POST /api/auth/login with valid credentials returns access_token, user, must_change_password (200)
Backend: POST /api/auth/login with invalid credentials returns 401 with 'Invalid email or password'
Backend: POST /api/auth/login with empty email returns 422 validation error
Backend: GET /api/auth/me with valid token returns user data (200)
Backend: POST /api/auth/refresh with valid token returns new access_token (200)
UI: Empty fields validation shows toast 'Please fill in all fields' and stays on /login
UI: Invalid credentials shows error toast 'Invalid email or password' and stays on /login
UI: Valid credentials (admin@shardahr.com) redirects to /dashboard with 'Welcome back!' toast
UI: Dashboard displays user name 'System Administrator'
UI: Session persistence - user stays on dashboard for 10+ seconds (no race condition logout)
UI: Navigation to Employees page works
UI: Protected route /dashboard redirects to /login when not authenticated
critical_code_review_comments: utils/api.js: Universal API client correctly detects native platform via window.Capacitor?.isNativePlatform?.()
utils/api.js: webRequest() uses robust response parsing with clone().text() then JSON.parse()
utils/api.js: nativeRequest() uses CapacitorHttp.request() directly - bypasses WebView entirely
AuthContext.js: All auth calls (login, register, me, refresh, logout) use apiRequest() - no direct fetch
LoginPage.js: Uses apiRequest for change-password, login() from AuthContext for login
Minor: DialogContent accessibility warnings in console - consider adding VisuallyHidden DialogTitle
context_for_next_testing_agent: Universal API client (utils/api.js) verified on web platform - all auth flows working. Key changes: apiRequest() uses CapacitorHttp.request() directly in native (bypasses WebView), standard fetch on web. AuthContext.js uses apiRequest() for all auth calls. The mobile-specific fixes (CapacitorHttp) cannot be tested in browser but web behavior is not regressed. Login, dashboard, session persistence, navigation, logout, and protected routes all working correctly.
